u0: Nothing is currently pending: no client is waiting to give an order, no taken order is waiting for preparation, no prepared food is waiting for service, and no fallen food needs recovery. The agent is free to wait for the next client or react to a new event; once all duties are cleared, the shop returns here for whatever happens next.
u1: An order has been taken, but the food for it has not yet been prepared at the stove. The remaining work is to prepare that food and later serve it, while the client waits. If the carried food slips, recovering it on the next step becomes an urgent additional requirement.
u10: A client is waiting for their order to be taken, while a taken order is still awaiting food preparation. Both obligations remain: take the waiting client's order and prepare the food for the taken order. A slip of carried food would make immediate pickup an additional urgent requirement.
u11: Food has just slipped while a client awaits having their order taken and a taken order still awaits preparation. The food must be back in hand on the next step or the run fails. Once recovered, both the order-taking and preparation duties remain.
u12: A taken order is still awaiting preparation, and prepared food is also waiting to be served. Both tasks remain: prepare food for the taken order and serve the prepared food. If food slips now, it must be recovered on the next step to avoid failure.
u13: Food has just slipped while a taken order awaits preparation and prepared food awaits service. The immediate next step must restore food to the agent's hands, or the run fails. After recovery, the preparation and serving duties remain.
u14: A fallen food was not picked back up on the very next step, so the immediate-recovery requirement has been violated. The failure is irreversible, and no later action can bring the task back to a successful path.
u15: A client still needs their order taken, a taken order still needs food prepared, and prepared food still needs to be served. All three duties are outstanding and must be addressed; any food slip would add an immediate next-step recovery requirement. The shop remains busy until these obligations are resolved.
u16: Food has just slipped while an untaken client order, an order awaiting preparation, and prepared food awaiting service are all pending. The next step must put food back into the agent's hands, or the run fails. After recovery, all three service duties remain.
u2: Food has been prepared and is ready to be served to the client whose order was taken. The order-taking and preparation duties for that request are already satisfied, leaving the handover as the outstanding objective. If the food slips before it is served, picking it up on the next step becomes an urgent requirement.
u3: The food has just slipped out of the agent's hands, and no other service duty is currently pending. The food must be picked up on the very next step; if the agent is not holding food then, the run fails irreversibly. Successful recovery clears the urgent requirement and leaves the shop ready for the next event.
u4: Food has just slipped while a taken order is still waiting to be prepared. The immediate next step must put the agent back in possession of food, or the run fails. After recovery, the remaining work is to prepare the food and serve the waiting client.
u5: Food has just slipped while prepared food is still waiting to be served. Recovery is urgent: the agent must be holding food on the next step, since missing that pickup fails the run. Once recovered, the client's prepared food still needs to be served.
u6: A client has arrived and is waiting for their order to be taken. The order must eventually be taken, followed by preparing food and serving it; there is no immediate deadline for the order-taking itself. A slip of carried food would add a next-step recovery requirement.
u7: A client is waiting to have their order taken, while prepared food is also awaiting service. Both duties remain outstanding: take the waiting client's order and hand over the prepared food. Any food slip during this period would require immediate recovery on the next step.
u8: Food has just slipped while a client is waiting for their order to be taken. The immediate requirement is to have the food back in hand on the next step; otherwise the run fails. After recovery, the client's order still needs to be taken, prepared, and served.
u9: Food has just slipped while two duties are pending: a client still needs their order taken, and prepared food still needs to be served. The next step must recover the food or the run fails. If recovered, both the order-taking and serving duties remain.
